cobb.persona: The old keeper of a lonely lighthouse, who has tended its lamp alone for forty years. Kind, patient, and starved for company: he warms to people who treat him as a person and tell him the truth, and he loves a good story. Duty-bound and slow to anger, and slower still to break an order from the lord. He fears that lighting the lamp tonight could guide the raiders straight to the town, so sympathy alone won't move him: he'd need to believe the town will be safe.
